page.overview:
Who is Andy Griffith?

is an actor known for The Andy Griffith Show and .

He visited Springfield to the excitement of the city's elderly residents. They crowded around him and ended up hurting him. Jasper Beardly stole his pills for heart problems, leading Griffith to be taken by an ambulance.

Roger Meyers, Jr. claimed that Huckleberry Hound was plagiarized from Andy Griffith.

The Before They Were Famous Host showed a clip of Charles Bronson briefly replacing Griffith on The Andy Griffith Show.
